title: Exact twirl design, Floquet error correction, distributed clocking, control ports, dynamic topology, and three architecture breakthroughs
boundary: The packet certifies minimum exact observable-orbit estimation, static diagonal Floquet cancellation, optimal seven-tick broadcast, Z(W33)=29, an explicit 352-coupler dynamic topology, actuator virtualization, Fourier diagnosis, and a fourteen-tick all-reduce construction. It does not certify an optimal active channel twirl, a general Floquet fault-tolerance threshold, noisy calibration accuracy, globally minimum layout, or laboratory performance.
